newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 24.80 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 24.80 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate rose by 18 basis points to 24.80 percent on Wednesday, from 24.62 percent on Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said.
The TIIP meanwhile fell 46.35 basis points to 24.7928 percent on Wednesday from 25.2563 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE fell 30 basis points to 25.2250 percent on Wednesday from 25.5250 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
